headline: Charlie McAvoy returns in style as Bruins dominate the Sharks
morning_brew: Tuesday night was a damn good time for the B's, and having Charlie McAvoy back in the lineup felt like the missing piece finally snapped into place. He stepped onto the ice like he never spent a minute away, scoring in his first game back from suspension and helping us cruise to a 6-3 win over the Sharks. Jeremy Swayman was absolutely locked in between the pipes, turning away thirty-five shots to keep things settled while the offense kept the pressure on all night long. That is the kind of cohesive performance we need if we wanna keep this winning streak alive as we head out on this West Coast swing.

Over on Causeway Street, the C's finally did something sensible, locking up Payton Pritchard with a two-year extension. It is a wicked smart move by the front office to keep a spark plug like that in the rotation, especially with the grind of a regular season right around the corner. We have all seen what he can do when the lights are bright, and having him committed to the Hub for the next couple of years is a nice little boost for the squad. It is good to see ownership actually putting pen to paper instead of just talking about the future for a change.

The football side of things is a massive headache this morning with word that Will Campbell is dealing with an MCL sprain. Losing a guy on the offensive line is never what you wanna hear, especially with the Jets coming to Gillette this weekend, so I hope the medical staff has a plan to shuffle the deck. We have been grinding out some results lately, but the training room is getting crowded and we need the depth chart to step up. My neighbor Rick is already convinced this is some sort of league-wide plot against our tackle situation, and honestly, I am just praying he is wrong for once.

news_digest.headline: Celtics, Payton Pritchard agree to two-year extension
news_digest.dans_take: About damn time they locked him up so he can keep doing his thing in Boston.
